headline: K92 Mining Surpasses 1M Gold Ounces on Record Q3 Processing Output
summary: K92 Mining achieved a record-breaking third quarter, generating its highest quarterly throughput during its Stage 3 processing plant ramp-up in Papua New Guinea and crossing one million cumulative gold equivalent ounces produced to date.
why: K92 Mining operates the high-grade Kainantu gold mine in Papua New Guinea, an important contributor to the country's mineral export earnings.

impacts.name: K92 Mining
impacts.why: Record throughput and crossing the one-million-ounce production milestone demonstrate operational ramp-up success.
